equity_bridge.note: FY2025 Annual Report balance sheet, Note 26

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance (mid-to-high single digit CER) decaying toward the 2030 ambition (~$80bn revenue, ~6% CAGR from FY2025) and then the LOE cluster; equity CAGR is not usable as the driver because the July 2021 all-share Alexion acquisition (equity $15.6bn -> $39.3bn) is issuance, not compounding.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 25.5% vs revenue 17.2% and EPS 21.8%: the divergence is the $39bn Alexion share issuance in FY2021 and the FY2020-21 COVID-vaccine/one-off trough in EPS, not organic compounding. FCF CAGRs are on the owner series (reported FCF less purchased intangibles less SBC): FY2020 1,916 -> FY2022 6,618 -> FY2025 7,951.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF 3-yr CAGR 6.3% vs reported-FCF 10.5%: intangible purchases (1,480 -> 3,095) and SBC (619 -> 719) have grown faster than cash flow, so a rising share of reported FCF growth is being re-invested in in-licensed pipeline. 5-yr figures are inflated by the FY2020 base (Alexion not yet consolidated, COVID year).

scenario_narratives.base: Guidance delivered in FY2026 (+8% reported, Core EPS up low double digit) and the oncology / rare-disease / biopharma launch cohort carries revenue to ~$79bn by FY2030, close to the stated $80bn ambition. Reported EBITDA margin expands to 35% as PAAGR restructuring completes. From FY2031 the US loss-of-exclusivity cluster (Tagrisso 2032, Imfinzi, Ultomiris, Calquence) and IRA negotiated prices hold growth to 1.5-2.5% for three years before the 2026-30 launches (Dato-DXd, camizestrant, baxdrostat, oral GLP-1, Imfinzi perioperative, Enhertu new lines) restore 2.5% terminal growth. Pipeline replenishment (purchased intangibles) is a permanent charge, easing from 5% to ~3% of revenue inside a total capex line of 8% at maturity. Terminal value capped at 18x owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Everything in base plus the cardiometabolic / obesity franchise working (baxdrostat, AZD5004, amylin) and Dato-DXd / camizestrant fully replacing Tagrisso; FY2030 ~$84bn, 37% margins, LOE cluster grown through at 3-4.5%; 3.0% terminal growth, 20x cap.
scenario_narratives.bear: MFN/TrumpRx net-price commitments, IRA rounds (Farxiga 2026, Calquence 2027) and the expiry of the 3-year Section 232 tariff exemption compress US pricing from FY2027; China VBP weakens the second market; binary readouts keep failing at the FY2026 rate (CARDIO-TTRansform, EMERALD-2, CAPItello-280/281) so the pipeline only partially offsets the 2030-33 cliff and revenue falls 1-2% a year for three years; margin to 30%; capex stays elevated to buy in pipeline; 1.5% terminal growth, 15x cap.

valuation_philosophy.summary: AstraZeneca is valued as an operating company on fully-charged owner FCF: SBC expensed, share count flat, and the $2.5-3.3bn a year of purchased intangibles treated as the maintenance capex of a pharma franchise rather than as discretionary M&A. On that basis the market price sits above the house base value: the market is paying a Street multiple on core EPS that treats in-licensing spend and amortisation as non-cash and gives full credit for the 2030 ambition. The required-return table shows what IRR the current price implies; the 15% hurdle entry price is far below the quote, as it is for any 7.5%-WACC compounder.
key_risks_to_valuation: US drug-pricing policy: most-favoured-nation pricing, sectoral pharma tariffs, and IRA negotiated prices (Farxiga from 2026, Calquence from 2027) on the ~44% of revenue earned in the US
Loss-of-exclusivity cluster 2030-2033 (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Ultomiris, Calquence) following Farxiga, Lynparza and Soliris erosion
Pipeline binary events: Dato-DXd, camizestrant, baxdrostat, oral GLP-1 AZD5004, Imfinzi perioperative expansions
China: volume-based procurement, the import-tax / data investigations, and FX
Capital intensity: the $50bn US investment programme to 2030 and rising intangible purchases (H1 FY2026 15% of revenue) may persist longer than the capex glide assumes
FX bridge: the GBp value moves one-for-one with GBPUSD; a 5% stronger pound lowers the pence IV ~5% with no change in the USD model

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for AZN.L at inputs.price_as_of (regular LSE close); 52-week range 9,892-15,732p. GBPUSD=X and Nasdaq AZN from the same API for the FX bridge and parity check.
data_sources.financials: AZN.L_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2018-FY2025 annual, Q1/H1/Q2 FY2025-FY2026 interim); FY2025 Annual Report (cash flow statement, Note 29 share-based payments, Note 26 NCI); H1 FY2026 results announcement (Table 13 Net debt, diluted share count, FY2026 guidance).
data_sources.qualitative: FY2025 Annual Report strategy and outlook sections and the H1 FY2026 / Q2 FY2026 results releases; AZN.L_Analysis.json was not yet written when this valuation was built.

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted average, H1 FY2026 results (1,561m; basic 1,550m). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. No buyback programme; dilution from awards is settled via the employee trust (EBT share purchases $521m FY2025, $658m H1 FY2026), i.e. SBC is cash-settled in practice.
inputs.net_debt_note: AstraZeneca's own Net debt at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 Table 13): gross interest-bearing loans and borrowings $32,239m (incl. commercial paper $2,407m and lease liabilities $2,748m) less cash and investments $4,968m, less net derivative financial instruments $359m. Lease liabilities are INSIDE net debt (lease treatment A). Up from $23,374m at 31 Dec 2025 after the Q1 dividend and $3.3bn of H1 intangible purchases.
inputs.fcf_definition_note: Metrics.csv FreeCashFlow (OCF 14,575 - PP&E capex 2,810 = 11,765) excludes purchase of intangible assets (3,095 in FY2025; 2,662 FY2024; 2,417 FY2023; 3,333 in H1 FY2026 alone). For a pharma these milestone / in-licensing payments are pipeline replenishment that sustains the franchise, so they are treated as maintenance-like capex: reported_fcf here = 11,765 - 3,095 = 8,670, and last_fcf (owner FCF) = 8,670 - SBC 719 = 7,951. The forward capex_pct_path covers PP&E, intangible purchases and lease-asset renewal together. Note reported OCF is after $1,316m interest paid; the engine's unlevered build adds that back implicitly, so the component FY2026 FCF (~15%+ of revenue) sits above the 13.5% levered owner-FCF margin of FY2025 by roughly the after-tax interest.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report, Share-based payments charge for the period (Note 29) $719m; EquityAwardTaxes not separately disclosed (0). H1 FY2026 charge $389m (1.27% of revenue).
inputs.interest_income_note: Finance income $360m FY2025 is NOT stripped: the group is a $26.9bn net debtor, so there is no cash pile being double-counted.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in USD; LSE quote in pence (GBp). Per-share values are computed in USD and converted at GBPUSD 1.324 (Yahoo GBPUSD=X, 2026-10-02T21:29Z): fx_rate = 100 / 1.324 = 75.529 pence per USD. Parity check: Nasdaq AZN closed $156.90 on 2026-10-02 and 11,870p x 1.324 / 100 = $157.16, a 0.2% tie, confirming the 1:1 ordinary-share basis across New York / London / Stockholm after the 2 February 2026 listing harmonisation. refresh_price.py moves the price but not the rate: re-anchor by editing gbpusd_spot / fx_rate here and rebuilding.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T15:36:52Z regular LSE close (Friday); valuation written Monday 2026-10-05 before the open
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD-built rate: 10y UST ~4.1% + 5.0% ERP x 0.70 beta (house floor for a mega-cap exposed to US drug-pricing policy; observed beta ~0.5) = 7.6% cost of equity; A1/A+ debt ~4.5% pre-tax, ~3.5% after tax; ~90/10 equity/debt weights give ~7.2%, rounded up to 7.5%. One WACC for all three scenarios: patent-cliff, pricing-policy and pipeline risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt: lease liabilities ($2,748m at 30 Jun 2026) sit inside net debt; lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows; right-of-use depreciation ($404m FY2025) is inside D&A and added back, with ongoing lease-asset renewal (~0.6% of revenue) carried inside capex_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are immaterial ($52m book at 31 Dec 2025, $16m of FY2025 profit); deducted once in the equity bridge at book, flows left consolidated.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing: large profitable operating company; first valuation of this ticker, no memory entry). Fresh build. House basis expenses SBC and holds the count flat; purchased intangibles treated as maintenance capex (see fcf_definition_note). FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); Y1 = FY2026, for which H1 is reported (revenue +9.4%, EBITDA margin 34.9%) and guidance is reconfirmed: Total Revenue up mid-to-high single digit at CER (+ low-single-digit FX tailwind), Core EPS up low double digit, Core tax rate 18-22%. Cash taxes paid ($2,845m FY2025) calibrate to ~22% of SBC-adjusted EBIT, above the 18% Core rate, hence the 22-23% cash_tax_rate_path. Horizon 10 years so the 2030-2033 loss-of-exclusivity cluster (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Ultomiris, Calquence US; Farxiga/Lynparza earlier) sits inside the explicit period rather than in the terminal year. Price is the Friday 2026-10-02 regular close, not after-hours; the Nasdaq parity check ties to 0.2%.

bear.narrative: US pricing policy bites: most-favoured-nation pricing and sectoral tariffs on top of IRA negotiation (Farxiga 2026, Calquence 2027, Tagrisso/Imfinzi in later rounds) cap US growth, and China volume-based procurement plus the Chinese import-tax investigation weigh on the second-largest market. Dato-DXd, baxdrostat and the obesity programme deliver only partially, so the 2030-33 LOE cluster (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Ultomiris, Calquence) produces three years of revenue decline. Replenishment spend has to rise as a share of a shrinking top line (capex 9%+ through the cliff); margin erodes to 30%; terminal exit 15x, 1.5% growth.

base.growth_note: FY2026 8.0% reported (guidance mid-to-high single digit CER plus ~2pp FX; H1 was +9.4%). FY2027-30 decays 6.5/6.0/5.5/4.5 -> FY2030 revenue ~$79bn, a touch under the $80bn ambition. FY2031-33 1.5-2.5% as Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Ultomiris and Calquence lose US exclusivity and IRA negotiated prices bite (Farxiga 2026, Calquence 2027); recovery to 2.5% as the 2026-30 launches mature.
base.margin_note: Reported EBITDA margin 33.2% FY2025, 34.9% H1 FY2026. Base lifts to 35% by FY2028 (operating leverage, PAAGR restructuring complete end-2026) then gives back 1pp through the LOE cluster. Reported basis, so restructuring, legal and fair-value items stay in the margin.
base.capex_note: PP&E + purchased intangibles + lease renewal. FY2025 10.1% of revenue, H1 FY2026 15.1% (the $50bn US manufacturing/R&D programme to 2030 plus $3.3bn of intangible upfronts incl. CSPC $1.1bn). 12.0% FY2026 (H1 $4.6bn plus H2 Dizal/Sino Biopharm upfronts; the $2bn Summit stake is an equity investment, outside this line) easing to 8% = D&A at terminal.
base.da_note: 9.8% FY2025, of which acquired-intangible amortisation is roughly half; glides to 8% as Alexion amortisation runs off.
base.tax_note: Cash taxes paid / SBC-adjusted EBIT = 21.8% FY2025 (Core rate 18%, cash rate higher because of prior-period settlements and non-deductible amortisation). 22% rising to 23% for Pillar Two and the shift of profit into the US.
base.wc_note: Receivables + inventory exceed payables for a manufacturer; H1 FY2026 showed working-capital outflows. 10% of each year's revenue increase is consumed.

bull.narrative: FY2030 revenue ~$84bn, above the ambition, and the LOE cluster is grown through: Enhertu/Dato-DXd/camizestrant/Truqap expansions and Imfinzi perioperative data replace Tagrisso volume; baxdrostat and the oral GLP-1 (AZD5004) and amylin assets open cardiometabolic/obesity franchises outside oncology; Ultomiris/Koselugo/eplontersen sustain rare disease. Margin reaches 37% as launches scale over a fixed cost base. Intangible spend eases to 7.5% as the internal pipeline supplies more of the replenishment.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the house 15/50/35 to 25/50/25. Bull weight down because it needs several independent things to go right (obesity/cardiometabolic assets, Dato-DXd and camizestrant readouts, LOE cluster bridged) in a company whose pipeline is already the consensus thesis. Bear weight up because the downside axis is policy rather than execution: US most-favoured-nation pricing, pharma tariffs, IRA negotiation and China procurement are outside management's control and all land before or during the 2030-33 cliff. No going-concern or covenant element (A1/A+ rated), so the bear is a value compression, not a solvency case.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
